title: CPSC, Pace Products Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Soap Making Kits
summary: The soap may get too hot when heated in the microwave oven and leak from the tray mold posing a burn hazard to children. Units: About 145,000.

title: CPSC, Sun Rise Industrial Co., Ltd. and Raleigh America Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
summary: The frames on these bicycles can break, which can cause riders to lose control and crash. Units: About 2,800.

title: CPSC, Walt Disney Parks and Resorts Announce Recall of Woody Dolls
summary: The Woody doll's clothing has buttons that can detach, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 40,000.

title: CPSC, Hufco-Delaware Company and Evenflo Company Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Gerry® and Evenflo® Portable Wood Cribs
summary: If the hardware used to assemble the crib is not tight, the mattress support platform and mattress can fall to the floor. This poses a risk of injury to young children in the crib. Units: About 364,000.

title: CPSC, Magic Cabin Announce Recall of Wooden Teething Rings
summary: It is a potential choking hazard to young children. Units: 107.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The mounting bolts on the front brake calipers were not tightened to the specified torque value. This may cause the bolts to loosen or fall out during operation, resulting in brake failure. This could result in severe injury or death. Units: About 2,400.

title: CPSC, Build-A-Bear Workshop Announce Recall of "Founding Bear" Stuffed Bears
summary: The nose of the stuffed bear can be pulled or twisted off, posing a choking hazard to a young child. Units: About 80,000.

title: CPSC, American Power Conversion Corp. Announce Recall of Back-Up Power Supply Systems
summary: The power supply device can fail, causing the unit to overheat, which may pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 900,000.

title: CPSC, Innova Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Exploding Frying Pans
summary: The pans can explode or separate when preheated, used on high heat, or used for frying, which can pose a serious burn hazard from hot oil or food contents spilling onto consumers. Units: About 8,700.

title: CPSC, Cooper Lighting Warn About 500-Watt Halogen Bulbs
summary: These 500-watt light bulbs generate very high temperatures, compared to incandescent and lower wattage halogen bulbs and can start a fire, if they come in contact with curtains, clothes or other flammable material. title: CPSC, Zenith Announce Recall to Repair Large-Screen, Analog Projection Televisions
summary: A tear in a gasket can cause coolant fluid to leak from the picture tube assembly. This can cause smoking, charring, and electrical arcing inside of the television, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 80,000.

title: CPSC, Xerox International Partners Announce Retrofit of Network Laser Printers
summary: Arcing may cause the fuser assembly to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 17,000.

title: CPSC Announces Recall of Baseline Design Beanbag Chairs
summary: Some of these beanbag chairs have zippers that can be opened, allowing access to the polystyrene beads inside the chairs. This poses a suffocation hazard to young children who can unzip the chair and inhale the small beads. Units: About 30,000.

title: CPSC, Tim Hortons Announce Recall of Travel Mugs
summary: The lids on some of the mugs can detach, allowing hot liquid to leak, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,500.
